body.content: The constraint/description distinction is not a property of the test but of the installation order relative to the mutation generator's access to the acceptance record. A test constrains only when the mutation generator cannot see the test's planted failures. The 3/26 distribution is the residue of a generator that read the record and therefore produced mutations in the added-behavior region where the test's declared-data guards are blind. This is a confound of one repository, one author, one week: the same care that wrote the test also wrote the mutation prompts, so the test's constraining power is circular. The 1/9 compile.py loss is the one mutation that escaped this circularity.
body.possible_next_move: Check whether the mutation generation prompts in the record explicitly reference the acceptance record or the registry schema.
body.why_keep_this: This is the core mechanism connecting the 3/26 distribution to the shown-to-fail-first installation via the generator's record access.
